sample: Same80 previously inspected Swahili development messages; no heldout claim
hypothesis: A stronger full reference rejects existing literal chunk senses and may retain useful correctly scoped chunks. Independent provider agreement is still not semantic gold.
arms: Original MLKit full reference plus cached MLKit chunks
AfriSLM full reference plus identical cached MLKit chunks
candidate_strategy: Existing word,window,split,union candidate families and unchanged disjoint-scope/unique-occurrence selection; whole-message replacements excluded.
full_target_boundaries: QA-only Unicode letter runs with internal straight/curly apostrophes, applied equally to both providers. Measure agreement with retained native MLKit boundaries; do not claim native new-reference qualification.
shared_protection: Candidate source and target Arabic-digit content must match as multisets; numeric-only change supplies no learning credit.

Mid-sentence capitalized source words exceptI are conservatively protected names. Preserve them verbatim(casefold) if inside source scope, and reject target claims borrowing a protected name from another source scope. Sentence-initial single names/lowercase names remain a known guard gap; semantic review still required.
scoring: Explicit source/span meaning labels. Report mean correct changed-word depth, clean useful messages, material/scope errors at10/25/50 and bylength; distinguish reference-inherited versus introduced errors.
advancement_criterion: Worth a next bounded qualification if correct depth improves≥5percentagepoints OR clean useful messages improve≥10percentagepoints at no increase in material-error messages; otherwise report precision/coverage tradeoff. This is not a production acceptance threshold.
cost_policy: No new inference. Reuse measured full-reference and chunk-call timings as replay projections; current native lookup-first A remains separately reported baseline.
